<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
.tm-page{--tm-hero:url('https://YOUR-SITE.com/wp-content/uploads/tideman/hero.jpg');--tm-water:url('https://YOUR-SITE.com/wp-content/uploads/tideman/bg-water.jpg');--tm-blueprint:url('https://YOUR-SITE.com/wp-content/uploads/tideman/bg-blueprint.jpg');}
/* Tideman Marine – Fire Rescue landing
   Every rule is scoped under .tm-page so the same file works as a standalone
   stylesheet and as the custom-CSS block inside the Elementor template. */

.tm-page {
  --tm-black: #0a0a0a;
  --tm-ink: #111214;
  --tm-panel: #16181b;
  --tm-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  --tm-amber: #f5a800;
  --tm-red: #e0452b;
  --tm-steel: #b3b9c0;
  --tm-white: #f5f6f7;
  --tm-display: "Bebas Neue", "Oswald", Impact, sans-serif;
  --tm-body: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --tm-img: "";
  background: var(--tm-black);
  color: var(--tm-white);
  font-family: var(--tm-body);
  line-height: 1.65;
  width: 100%;
  overflow-x: clip;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.tm-page *, .tm-page *::before, .tm-page *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.tm-page img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.tm-page a { text-decoration: none; }

/* ---- Neutralise Elementor container / widget defaults ---- */
.tm-page .e-con {
  --padding-top: 0px; --padding-bottom: 0px; --padding-left: 0px; --padding-right: 0px;
  --gap: 0px; --row-gap: 0px; --column-gap: 0px;
  padding: 0; gap: 0; margin: 0; border-radius: 0; min-width: 0;
}
.tm-page .elementor-widget:not(:last-child) { margin-block-end: 0; margin-bottom: 0; }
.tm-page .elementor-widget { min-width: 0; }

/* ---- Layout helpers ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-sec { padding: 96px 0; position: relative; align-items: stretch; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-alt { background: var(--tm-ink); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-wrap { width: calc(100% - 48px); max-width: 1180px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-row { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-g2, .tm-page .e-con.tm-g3, .tm-page .e-con.tm-g4, .tm-page .e-con.tm-split { display: grid; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-g2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-g3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-g4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-split { grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-split.tm-flip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-top { align-items: start; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-gap-s { gap: 10px; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-gap-m { gap: 18px; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-gap-l { gap: 28px; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-gap-xl { gap: 48px; }

/* ---- Typography ---- */
.tm-page .elementor-heading-title { font-family: var(--tm-display); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .02em; line-height: 1.02; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tm-white); margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.tm-page h1.elementor-heading-title { font-size: clamp(2.7rem, 6vw, 5.2rem); }
.tm-page h2.elementor-heading-title { font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4vw, 3.4rem); }
.tm-page h3.elementor-heading-title { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 2rem); letter-spacing: .03em; }
.tm-page h4.elementor-heading-title { font-size: 1.15rem; font-family: var(--tm-body); font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: none; color: var(--tm-amber); line-height: 1.3; }
.tm-page .elementor-heading-title span { color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .elementor-widget-text-editor { color: var(--tm-steel); font-family: var(--tm-body); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; }
.tm-page .elementor-widget-text-editor p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: inherit; }
.tm-page .elementor-widget-text-editor p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.tm-page .elementor-widget-text-editor strong { color: var(--tm-white); font-weight: 700; }
.tm-page .elementor-widget-text-editor a { color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-eyebrow { color: var(--tm-amber); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.tm-page .tm-eyebrow p { margin: 0; color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 34px; height: 3px; background: var(--tm-amber); flex: none; }
.tm-page .tm-lead { font-size: 1.12rem; color: #cfd3d8; max-width: 54ch; }
.tm-page .tm-narrow { max-width: 780px; }

/* ---- Buttons ---- */
.tm-page .elementor-button { font-family: var(--tm-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; padding: 17px 30px; border: 2px solid var(--tm-amber); border-radius: 0; background: var(--tm-amber); color: var(--tm-black); transition: .2s ease; display: inline-flex; fill: currentColor; }
.tm-page .elementor-button:hover, .tm-page .elementor-button:focus { background: transparent; color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-ghost .elementor-button { background: transparent; color: var(--tm-white); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .4); }
.tm-page .tm-ghost .elementor-button:hover { border-color: var(--tm-amber); color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-small .elementor-button { padding: 12px 22px; font-size: .74rem; }

/* ---- Top bar + nav ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-topbar { background: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-topbar .tm-wrap { flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 0; gap: 16px; }
.tm-page .tm-topbar .elementor-widget-text-editor, .tm-page .tm-topbar .elementor-widget-text-editor p { color: var(--tm-black); font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: rgba(10, 10, 10, .92); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tm-line); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-nav .tm-wrap { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 76px; gap: 24px; }
.tm-page .tm-brand { flex: none; }
.tm-page .tm-brand .elementor-heading-title { white-space: nowrap; font-size: 1.8rem; letter-spacing: .06em; border: 2px solid var(--tm-white); padding: 5px 12px 2px; display: inline-block; }
.tm-page .tm-brand .elementor-heading-title span { color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-menu { flex: none; }
.tm-page .tm-menu p { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; white-space: nowrap; gap: 28px; margin: 0; }
.tm-page .tm-menu a { color: var(--tm-white); font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tm-page .tm-menu a:hover { color: var(--tm-amber); }

/* ---- Hero ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-hero { min-height: min(84vh, 760px); justify-content: center; padding: 0; background-color: var(--tm-black); background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #0a0a0a 0%, #0a0a0a 38%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .6) 52%, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0) 72%), linear-gradient(0deg, #0a0a0a 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0) 24%), var(--tm-hero); background-size: cover; background-position: right center; background-repeat: no-repeat; overflow: hidden; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-hero .tm-wrap { padding: 90px 0 120px; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-hero-copy { max-width: 540px; gap: 24px; }
.tm-page .tm-hero .tm-lead { margin-bottom: 8px; }

/* ---- Stats ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-stats { margin-top: -60px; position: relative; z-index: 5; padding: 0; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-stats-grid { background: var(--tm-panel); border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); border-top: 3px solid var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-stat { padding: 28px; border-right: 1px solid var(--tm-line); gap: 2px; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-stat:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.tm-page .tm-stat .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 2.5rem; color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-stat .elementor-widget-text-editor, .tm-page .tm-stat .elementor-widget-text-editor p { font-size: .76rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* ---- Media ---- */
.tm-page .tm-media { position: relative; }
.tm-page .tm-media img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); }
.tm-page .tm-media::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -14px; bottom: -14px; width: 52%; height: 52%; border-right: 4px solid var(--tm-amber); border-bottom: 4px solid var(--tm-amber); pointer-events: none; }
.tm-page .tm-flip .tm-media::after { right: auto; left: -14px; border-right: 0; border-left: 4px solid var(--tm-amber); }

/* ---- Lists ---- */
.tm-page .tm-checks ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px 28px; }
.tm-page .tm-checks.tm-one ul { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.tm-page .tm-checks li { position: relative; padding-left: 28px; color: var(--tm-white); font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }
.tm-page .tm-checks li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: .35em; width: 14px; height: 7px; border-left: 3px solid var(--tm-amber); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--tm-amber); transform: rotate(-45deg); }
.tm-page .tm-equip ul { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0 32px; }
.tm-page .tm-equip li { padding: 13px 0 13px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tm-line); }
.tm-page .tm-equip li::before { top: 50%; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 0; background: var(--tm-red); transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); }
.tm-page .tm-tags ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
.tm-page .tm-tags li { padding: 11px 18px; background: var(--tm-panel); border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); color: var(--tm-white); font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; transition: .2s; }
.tm-page .tm-tags li:hover { border-color: var(--tm-amber); color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-mini ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.tm-page .tm-mini li { font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 168, 0, .45); color: #e9c76a; margin: 0; }

/* ---- Panels / cards ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-panel { background: var(--tm-panel); border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); border-left: 4px solid var(--tm-amber); padding: 30px; gap: 18px; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-card { background: var(--tm-panel); border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); padding: 28px 24px; gap: 12px; transition: .2s; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-card:hover { border-color: var(--tm-amber); transform: translateY(-4px); }
.tm-page .tm-card .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 1.45rem; }
.tm-page .tm-card .elementor-widget-text-editor { font-size: .93rem; line-height: 1.6; }
.tm-page .tm-num .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--tm-amber); letter-spacing: .12em; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-mission-grid { gap: 1px; background: var(--tm-line); border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-mission { background: var(--tm-ink); padding: 28px 24px; min-height: 130px; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; transition: .2s; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-mission:last-child { grid-column: span 2; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-mission:hover { background: #1c1f23; }
.tm-page .tm-mission h3.elementor-heading-title { font-size: 1.35rem; }

/* ---- Blueprint section ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-blueprint { background-color: var(--tm-black); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0a0a 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .82) 28%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .82) 72%, #0a0a0a 100%), var(--tm-blueprint); background-size: cover; background-position: center; }
.tm-page .tm-ga { background: #fff; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); }
.tm-page .tm-ga img { width: 100%; }
.tm-page .tm-caption, .tm-page .tm-caption p { font-size: .76rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tm-steel); }

/* ---- Firefighting section ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-firefight { background-color: var(--tm-black); background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(10, 10, 10, .96) 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .86) 55%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .55) 100%), var(--tm-water); background-size: cover; background-position: center; }

/* ---- Series ---- */

/* ---- Series cards ---- */
.tm-page .tm-series-title .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 2.2rem; color: var(--tm-white); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
.tm-page .tm-series-title .elementor-heading-title::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--tm-amber), rgba(245, 168, 0, 0)); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-scard { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1b1e22 0%, #121417 100%); border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); border-top: 4px solid var(--tm-amber); padding: 30px 26px 26px; gap: 14px; transition: .25s; }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-scard:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(245, 168, 0, .6); box-shadow: 0 24px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); }
.tm-page .tm-letter { position: absolute; top: -10px; right: 22px; pointer-events: none; width: auto; }
.tm-page .tm-letter .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 9rem; line-height: 1; color: rgba(245, 168, 0, .09); }
.tm-page .tm-scard h3.elementor-heading-title { font-size: 1.55rem; position: relative; }
.tm-page .tm-lead-s { font-size: .95rem; position: relative; }
.tm-page .tm-more { margin-top: auto; }
.tm-page .tm-more details { border-top: 1px solid var(--tm-line); padding-top: 14px; margin-top: 4px; }
.tm-page .tm-more summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--tm-amber); font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tm-page .tm-more summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.tm-page .tm-more summary::after { content: "+"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--tm-amber); font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; transition: .2s; }
.tm-page .tm-more details[open] summary::after { content: "–"; background: var(--tm-amber); color: var(--tm-black); }
.tm-page .tm-more details[open] summary { margin-bottom: 18px; }
.tm-page .tm-more p { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: .92rem; }
.tm-page .tm-more h4 { font-family: var(--tm-body); font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.02rem; color: var(--tm-amber); margin: 20px 0 10px; line-height: 1.3; }
.tm-page .tm-more h4:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.tm-page .tm-more ul { margin: 0 0 16px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
.tm-page .tm-more li { font-size: .88rem; }

/* ---- CTA + form ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-cta { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #14161a, #0a0a0a); border-top: 3px solid var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-form { width: 100%; }
.tm-page .tm-form form, .tm-page .tm-form .elementor-form { display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.tm-page .tm-form .elementor-form-fields-wrapper { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; margin: 0; }
.tm-page .tm-form .elementor-field-group { flex: 1 1 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; }
.tm-page .tm-form .elementor-col-50 { flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 7px); }
.tm-page .tm-form label { font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tm-steel); }
.tm-page .tm-form input, .tm-page .tm-form select, .tm-page .tm-form textarea { width: 100%; background: var(--tm-panel); border: 1px solid var(--tm-line); border-radius: 0; color: var(--tm-white); padding: 14px 16px; font: inherit; font-size: .95rem; }
.tm-page .tm-form input:focus, .tm-page .tm-form select:focus, .tm-page .tm-form textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--tm-amber); }
.tm-page .tm-form textarea { min-height: 130px; resize: vertical; }
.tm-page .tm-form button, .tm-page .tm-form .elementor-button { font-family: var(--tm-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 17px 30px; border: 2px solid var(--tm-amber); border-radius: 0; background: var(--tm-amber); color: var(--tm-black); cursor: pointer; transition: .2s; }
.tm-page .tm-form button:hover, .tm-page .tm-form .elementor-button:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--tm-amber); }

/* ---- Footer ---- */
.tm-page .e-con.tm-footer { padding: 36px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--tm-line); }
.tm-page .e-con.tm-footer .tm-wrap { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.tm-page .tm-footer .elementor-widget-text-editor, .tm-page .tm-footer .elementor-widget-text-editor p { font-size: .8rem; margin: 0; }

/* ---- Tablet ---- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-sec { padding: 72px 0; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-nav .tm-menu { display: none; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-g4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-g3 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-split, .tm-page .e-con.tm-split.tm-flip { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 40px; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-split.tm-flip .tm-media { order: -1; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-media-first .tm-media { order: -1; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-g2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 40px; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-g2.tm-keep2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-hero { background-position: 68% center; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #0a0a0a 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .85) 55%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .3) 100%), linear-gradient(0deg, #0a0a0a 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0) 24%), var(--tm-hero); }
  .tm-page .tm-equip ul { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-stat:nth-child(2) { border-right: 0; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-stat:nth-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tm-line); }
  .tm-page .tm-media { margin-right: 14px; }
}

/* ---- Phone ---- */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-sec { padding: 56px 0; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-wrap { width: calc(100% - 36px); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-topbar .tm-wrap { justify-content: center; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-topbar .tm-wrap .elementor-widget:last-child { display: none; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-nav .tm-small { display: none; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-nav .tm-wrap { min-height: 64px; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-g4, .tm-page .e-con.tm-g2.tm-keep2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-mission:last-child { grid-column: auto; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-stat { padding: 20px 16px; }
  .tm-page .tm-stat .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 2rem; }
  .tm-page .tm-checks ul, .tm-page .tm-equip ul { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-hero .tm-wrap { padding: 64px 0 100px; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-hero { background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10, 10, 10, .78) 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, .9) 100%), linear-gradient(0deg, #0a0a0a 0%, rgba(10, 10, 10, 0) 24%), var(--tm-hero); }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-row > .elementor-widget-button, .tm-page .e-con.tm-row > .elementor-widget-button .elementor-button { width: 100%; justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
  .tm-page .tm-form .elementor-col-50 { flex: 1 1 100%; }
  .tm-page .e-con.tm-panel { padding: 22px 18px; }
  .tm-page .tm-series-title .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 1.7rem; }
  .tm-page .tm-letter .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 7rem; }
}
</style>

settings.title: Fire Boats and Rescue Boats Built for Emergency Response

settings.editor: Tideman Marine designs and manufactures mission-ready fire boats and rescue boats for fire departments, municipalities, emergency response agencies, harbor authorities, and public safety organizations. Built from durable HDPE, Tideman Marine boats provide rugged, low-maintenance platforms for marine firefighting, search and rescue, flood response, dive operations, emergency medical response, and public safety missions.
Overall length
Beam
Hull construction
Draft design
Mission-ready platforms

From compact, shallow-draft rescue boats to larger, fully outfitted fire boats, Tideman Marine platforms can be configured around the specific equipment, personnel, waterways, and response requirements of each department.

Whether responding on lakes, rivers, harbors, coastal waters, flood zones, or shallow waterways, Tideman Marine builds fire and rescue boats around the mission.

settings.editor: F-Series

settings.title: F-Series Flat Series Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor:
The Tideman Marine F-Series, or Flat Series, is a versatile HDPE platform that can be configured for fire rescue and emergency response operations. Its shallow-draft design makes the Flat Series particularly well suited for departments that need access to rivers, lakes, flood zones, shorelines, and other areas where water depth or submerged hazards may limit conventional rescue vessels.

Configured as a rescue boat, the F-Series can support marine firefighting, search and rescue, flood response, dive operations, emergency medical response, victim recovery, and public safety missions.

The featured General Arrangement (GA) print showcases a 23' long × 8'6" beam Tideman Marine F-Series Flat Series platform outfitted specifically for fire rescue operations.

The Flat Series provides emergency response teams with a rugged and versatile rescue boat platform designed around shallow-water access, stability, deck space, and mission flexibility.

The featured configuration incorporates:

• 23' overall length
  • 8'6" beam
  • HDPE hull construction
  • Flat Series shallow-draft hull design
  • Enclosed patrol-style cabin
  • Large working and rescue deck
  • Side boarding and dive door access
  • Outboard propulsion
  • Emergency lighting and electronics
  • Rescue and recovery equipment storage
  • Configurable equipment and personnel arrangements
This F-Series configuration demonstrates how a Tideman Marine platform can be outfitted as a purpose-built fire department rescue boat for professional emergency response.

Search and rescue

Rapid access, stability, durability, and usable deck space can make a critical difference during a marine emergency. Tideman Marine rescue boats can be configured for quick deployment of firefighters, rescue personnel, divers, medical teams, and specialized emergency equipment.

settings.title: Shallow-Water Rescue Boats for Fire Departments

settings.editor:
Shallow-water rescue boats can be particularly important during emergencies in rivers, marshes, lakes, flood zones, coastal areas, and other low-water environments.

The shallow-draft F-Series Flat Series helps emergency crews access areas where deeper-draft vessels may have difficulty operating.

Depending on department requirements, a shallow-water fire department rescue boat can be configured with:

• Open rescue and recovery areas
  • Dive and boarding doors
  • Patient recovery areas
  • Medical equipment storage
  • Rescue equipment storage
  • Emergency and scene lighting
  • Navigation and communications electronics
  • Searchlights
  • Tow points
  • Specialized seating
  • Enclosed or open helm arrangements
  • Firefighting equipment
These capabilities make the Flat Series a versatile platform for flood rescue, shoreline response, victim recovery, dive operations, and other boat fire rescue missions.

HDPE construction

Tideman Marine constructs its vessels using High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), providing characteristics that are particularly well suited for professional fire boats and rescue boats.

Emergency response vessels may encounter docks, submerged objects, debris, rocky shorelines, shallow water, saltwater, and other demanding conditions. HDPE provides departments with a rugged hull material designed for these real-world marine environments.

settings.title: Why HDPE Works for Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

image.alt: Deck detail of a Tideman Marine HDPE rescue boat with life ring and equipment case

settings.editor: HDPE provides excellent impact resistance for operations around docks, debris, rocky shorelines, and other demanding environments.
HDPE does not corrode from exposure to freshwater or saltwater, making it well suited for long-term marine service.
The HDPE hull does not require the same corrosion protection associated with many traditional marine materials.
HDPE is nonconductive and is not subject to galvanic corrosion.
HDPE itself is naturally buoyant, an important characteristic for a marine hull material.
HDPE construction works particularly well with rugged, shallow-draft workboat designs such as the F-Series Flat Series.
HDPE is designed to provide years of demanding marine service with relatively low hull maintenance.
If damage does occur, HDPE can be welded and repaired.

For departments whose rescue boats may encounter submerged debris, damaged docks, rocky shorelines, flood-related hazards, or other challenging conditions, HDPE can provide an important operational advantage.
More platforms

settings.title: Other Tideman Marine Series for Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor:
While the F-Series Flat Series provides an excellent shallow-draft platform for fire rescue operations, other Tideman Marine boat series can also be configured as fire boats and rescue boats.

The right platform depends on the department's waterways, crew size, equipment, operating conditions, required range, and primary mission.

settings.editor: The I-Series Inland Patrol is a strong option for fire departments operating on lakes, rivers, harbors, and inland waterways.

Configured as a fire rescue boat, the Inland Patrol can support marine firefighting, search and rescue, dive operations, emergency medical response, harbor patrol, and personnel transport.

Inland Patrol Rescue Boats for Emergency Response

An I-Series Inland Patrol rescue boat can be configured with equipment such as fire pumps and monitors, emergency lighting, searchlights, rescue equipment storage, electronics, communications equipment, dive access, and specialized crew seating.

This combination makes the Inland Patrol an option for departments that need one boat to perform both routine public safety and emergency response missions.

settings.title: I-Series Inland Utility Fire Boats and Rescue Boats

settings.editor: For departments that prioritize deck space, stability, and equipment capacity, the I-Series Inland Utility provides another versatile platform for fire boats and rescue boats.

The Inland Utility can provide valuable working space for pumps, hoses, rescue equipment, divers, medical personnel, and recovered victims.

Inland Utility Fire Department Rescue Boats

An Inland Utility fire department rescue boat could be particularly well-suited for:

  • Flood response
  • Shallow-water rescue
  • Dive operations

settings.title: I-Series Inland Landing Craft Rescue Boats

settings.editor: The I-Series Inland Landing Craft provides another approach to emergency response by offering direct access between the vessel and shoreline.

Landing Craft Rescue Boats for Flood and Disaster Response

A bow ramp can make it easier to move rescue personnel, equipment, patients, and emergency supplies between the rescue boat and shore.

This can make an Inland Landing Craft particularly useful for:

Built around your mission

settings.title: Fire Boats and Rescue Boats Configured Around Your Department

settings.editor:
Every fire department operates differently. A coastal department may require a substantial firefighting system, larger crew capacity, and an enclosed cabin, while an inland department may prioritize shallow draft, open deck space, rapid victim recovery, and trailerability.

Tideman Marine can configure fire boats and rescue boats around the specific requirements of the department and its operating environment.

Available configurations can include:

• Shallow-water rescue boats
  • Municipal fire boats
  • Fire department rescue boats
  • Search and rescue boats
  • Flood response boats
  • Dive support boats
  • Harbor and port response boats
  • Fire suppression boats
  • Multi-purpose emergency response boats
  • Coastal rescue boats

From the 23' F-Series Flat Series featured on this page to larger Inland and Coastal platforms, Tideman Marine provides departments with the ability to select the hull, layout, propulsion, cabin, equipment, and rescue features that best support their mission.
